title: AI Content Workflow App
summary: Laravel and React application that turns AI generation into a stateful writing workflow instead of a single prompt screen.
problem: Create a durable content workspace where briefs, analysis, drafts, conversations, and final output stay connected across the full writing lifecycle.
highlights: Used a shared ContentProject model to persist briefs, drafts, model settings, and final output.
Separated AI agents by workflow responsibility instead of pushing everything through one prompt layer.
Stored conversation threads, prompt runs, and streaming results to make the product stateful.

title: Bhive
summary: Ecommerce platform for Bahrain with support for multiple vendors, currently in development.
problem: Build the backend foundation for a multi-vendor commerce experience with the product and vendor workflows needed to scale beyond a single seller.
highlights: Worked as a backend engineer on the platform's API and product workflows.
Designed around multiple vendors rather than a single-store commerce model.
Continuing development toward a Bahrain-focused ecommerce product.

title: Faz3a
summary: Service booking platform for users, paired with a vendor app for service providers.
problem: Connect customers who need services with vendors who can provide them through coordinated booking, service, and vendor workflows.
highlights: Worked as a backend engineer across the user booking experience and vendor operations.
Supported separate application flows for customers and service providers.

title: The BER backend rebuild
summary: Laravel backend rebuild for theber.com focused on modular architecture, role-aware workflows, and production database performance.
problem: Replace a harder-to-maintain backend with a Laravel application that could support multiple user roles, project lifecycle operations, and a large production data set more reliably.
highlights: Rebuilt the backend of theber.com using Laravel with a modular, scalable architecture.
Designed role-based access control for builders, raters, modelers, admins, and students.
Optimized SQL queries on a large production database to reduce load and improve response times.
Developed APIs and file-handling workflows for plan management, submissions, and full project lifecycle operations.

title: Logbook
summary: Django-based web application for creating, editing, and managing structured logbook entries collaboratively.
problem: Give teams and individuals a cleaner way to record activities, processes, and experiments in a shared web workflow.
highlights: Focused on structured entry management rather than simple note storage.
Designed for collaborative record keeping in web form.
